why: RE-VERDICTED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 P3), was `declined`/`absent` as an rclcpp_action member folded onto `Client`: `rclcpp_action::Client::async_send_goal(goal, options)` ships (hosted), so the row described an API that no longer existed -- found by the new `misdeclared_absences` check. It correlates `same:ret`. ENVELOPE: it returns the goal-keyed `rclcpp::Future<GoalAccept>` rather than a `std::shared_future<GoalHandle::SharedPtr>` (RFC-0021: no blocking future); `auto f = client->async_send_goal(goal, opts);` compiles, the options' callbacks run during spin, and an empty future means the send failed. A freestanding build refuses it (`NROS_RCLCPP_REFUSE_ACTION_GOAL_HANDLE`, issue 2015).
